title: Nesting Selection Structures
bullets: Place one if statement inside another code block.
Trace the outer and inner conditions.
Use indentation to show which block contains each instruction.

title: Nested if Statements
paragraphs: Nesting places one if statement inside another code block.
A nested if can be inside an if, elif, or else block.
The outer if checks age >= 16. The inner if checks has_license.
Here, both conditions are True. The message is displayed.

title: When the Outer Condition Is False
paragraphs: Python checks the outer condition first.
Here, age >= 16 is False. Python skips the entire outer block.
The inner condition is never checked. No message is displayed.

title: When the Inner Condition Is False
paragraphs: The outer condition is True. Python enters its block.
The inner condition is False. Python skips the print instruction inside that block.

title: Indentation Defines the Block
paragraphs: Indented instructions belong to a code block.
The final print has one level of indentation. It belongs to the outer if block.
Here, age >= 16 is False. The final message is skipped.

title: After the Nested Block
paragraphs: The final print now starts at the left margin. It is outside both if blocks.
Python reaches this instruction after the selection structure.
The final message is displayed when age is 15.

title: Wrap Up
bullets: Nesting places a selection structure inside another code block.
Python reaches an inner condition only after entering its containing block.
Indentation shows which instructions belong to each block.
Instructions outside the selection structure run after that structure finishes.
